title: Director, Data Analytics - Trust & Safety
location: San Francisco, CA, US; Palo Alto, CA, US; Seattle, WA, US; Los Angeles, CA, US; New York, NY, US
searchText: Director, Data Analytics - Trust & Safety Pinterest About Pinterest: Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product. Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible. At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI. Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here . Role Summary Pinterest helps Pinners discover and do what they love, and enable advertisers to effectively engage with the ideal audience to meet their marketing objectives. Pinterest has grown into one of the world's largest consumer products and advertising platforms, boasting over 600 million monthly active users and generating more than $4 billion in annualized advertising revenue. Our ongoing business success is reliant on our capacity to accelerate product innovation, which in turn allows us to deliver increased value to both our Pinners and Advertisers. Pinterest is entering a new era—reimagining how trust, safety, and quality are measured, protected, and elevated across the digital landscape. Reporting to Pinterest’s VP of Trust & Safety, the Director, Data Analytics - Trust & Safety will lead a globally dispersed team of ~15 data analysts and project/program managers tasked with turning trust measurement into governed, self-serve decision systems for Policy, Ops, Legal, Product, and Engineering. As Director, Data Analytics - Trust & Safety, you will architect and accelerate our shift toward agentic, scenario‑driven analytics that measurably reduce time‑to‑detection (TTD) and time‑to‑mitigation (TTM) of harm, and make roadmap tradeoffs more defensible across safety, expression, and growth. You’ll stand up intelligent agents and scenario workflows where they matter most—incident impact sizing, policy/enforcement “what‑if” reviews, and Ops floor playbooks—so decisions that used to take days become consistent, auditable calls made in hours or minutes. This role isn’t just about reporting what happened; it’s about building the systems, agents, and simulators that help Pinterest see around corners and respond at the speed of the internet. You will democratize agentic data access, build always-on scenario simulators for abuse, fraud, and content quality, and turn incident impacts into seamless signals for continuous improvement. Your insights and systems will empower every stakeholder—from legal to operations, policy to product—to make bold, data-driven, and context-aware decisions in real time. What You’ll Do: Lead the Agentic Analytics Transformation: Spearhead the design and deployment of intelligent agents that proactively detect, simulate, and respond to abuse, fraud, and emerging risks—scaling our platform’s safety, quality, and trust for the long term. Build Scenario Simulators: Create interactive, scenario-based analytics that allow teams to model risk, test interventions, and validate new policy and moderation approaches before launch—protecting users, creators, and merchants at scale. Automate Incident Impact Scoping: Operationalize automated agent workflows that instantly assess and size the platform, reputational, and regulatory impact of safety incidents, enabling rapid escalation, crystal-clear retrospectives, and lessons learned. Democratize Agentic Insights: Build self-service, agent-driven data tools that empower non-technical teams to ask deep questions, run “what if” analyses, and generate actionable, data-backed outcomes without gatekeeping. Accelerate Multidisciplinary Response: Orchestrate agentic systems that unify signals from operations, policy, engineering, and legal—bridging every function with a single, trusted source of truth for incident response and ongoing intelligence. Benchmark and Elevate Standards: Track and anticipate industry and regulatory shifts, using agent-based and scenario-forecasting analytics to keep Pinterest ahead of risk and help set the global bar for platform trust and quality. What We’re Looking For: Transformation Leader: 8+ years driving major analytics or data science initiatives—preferably including agent-based modeling, AI/ML-driven workflow transformation, or large-scale incident management. Agentic Systems Builder: Hands-on experience designing, testing, and deploying automation, intelligent agents, or scenario simulators for risk, quality, or complex decision support. Incident & Scenario Expert: Skilled in incident impact scoping, post-incident analytics, and scenario planning or tabletop exercises—translating insights into systematic improvements. Cross-Functional Accelerator: Track record of enabling legal, policy, ops, product, and engineering teams to make independent, forward-facing, data-driven decisions via self-service or agentic tools. Storyteller & Evangelist: Exceptional communicator with a flair for making complex analytics and simulations actionable for every audience, and for championing transformation deep into the organization and externally. Relentless Innovator: Passion for positive, safe, and inspiring technology—always seeking what’s next and how agents or AI can elevate platform quality and user trust. Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, a related field or equivalent experience. Relocation Statement: This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model. In-Office Requirement Statement: We let the type of work you do guide the collaboration style. That means we're not always working in an office, but we continue to gather for key moments of collaboration and connection. This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration at least 1-2 times per week and therefore needs to be in a commutable distance from the Pinterest Palo Alto, San Francisco, Seattle, Los Angeles, or New York office. The role will also require regular travel within the country to meet clients and teams. #LI-HYBRID #LI-RR4 At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise. Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here . US based applicants only $226,975 — $397,206 USD Our Commitment to Inclusion: Pinterest is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions on the basis of merit. We want to have the best qualified people in every job. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member) or any other consideration made unlawful by applicable federal, state or local laws. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you require a medical or religious accommodation during the job application process, please complete this form for support.
